tools.name: morpho_get_supported_chains
tools.description: List every chain the Morpho MCP serves, by name, with whether Morpho Blue markets, Morpho Vaults (V1 or V2) and Midnight are supported on it. Blue and Vault support come from the Morpho API chain list the read tools use; Midnight support also requires the chain to be accepted by the Midnight tools.

tools.name: morpho_get_token_balance
tools.description: Get token balance and whether the user needs to approve Morpho or the Bundler before writing. Balance and allowances are self-describing TokenAmounts.

tools.name: morpho_simulate_transactions
tools.description: Simulate transactions on the latest block with eth_simulateV1 and check them against the limits of the Morpho action the user is taking, without sending anything. Use mode "preview" for unsigned calls, listing pending approvals or permits in `authorizations`; use mode "final" for calls whose signatures are already in the calldata, or pass a raw signed transaction as `signedTransaction`. `limits.operations` names each Morpho action in the bundle, for example `{ type: "vaultV2Deposit", vault, inputs: { assets } }` or `{ type: "blueBorrow", marketId, inputs: { assets } }`, so the simulation checks what the user pays, receives and holds; when a prepare tool returned `simulation_limits`, pass that as `limits`; use "none" only for bundles no operation type covers (reward claims, approval-only bundles). Amounts are integer strings in base units. Returns every simulated call, transfers, per-account asset changes and the checked limits, or `status: "failed"` with the error code and revert data. Health factor and LTV are not checked. Nothing is signed or sent.

tools.name: morpho_doc_search

topK.description: Maximum number of result chunks to return

scoreThreshold.description: Only return results scoring at or above this relevance score

rewriteQuery.description: Let the search service rewrite the query

tools.name: morpho_midnight_list_user_positions
tools.description:
Cursor-paginated list of a user's current Midnight positions.

**Position type.** `type` is `lend` for positions with credit, `borrow` for positions with debt, or `collateral_only` for positions with no credit or debt but remaining collateral. Closed positions with no credit, no debt, and no remaining collateral are excluded.

**Performance fields.** `cost_basis` uses the average cost method and is returned as a WAD-scaled bigint string in loan-token units. `effective_rate_wad` is the unchanged WAD-scaled compounded IRR+ using a 365.25-day year; `effective_apr` is the simple annualized decimal fraction using a 365-day year, capped at `10`, and derived from persisted open lots. Analytics can be `null` when there is not enough attributable history.

**Filters.** `chain_ids` is required when `loan_assets` is provided. `collateral_assets` matches configured market collateral tokens across all chains unless `chain_ids` narrows the query; lowercase addresses are checksummed. Range filters exist on `created_at`, `credit`, `debt`, `cost_basis`, and `effective_rate_wad`. `effective_apr` has no filter or sort key. `active_only=true` excludes matured markets. `listed=true` keeps only positions on listed markets; `listed=false` keeps only positions on unlisted markets.

**Pagination.** Response envelope: `{ cursor, data }`. Positions are ordered newest-first by `created_at` by default.

**Cache.** `public, max-age=2, stale-while-revalidate=1`.

tools.name: morpho_midnight_get_user_position
tools.description:
Detail lookup for a single position by `(market-id, user-address)`.

`:market-id` is the stable Midnight market id and is globally unique across supported chains. `:user-address` accepts any casing and is checksummed server-side.

Returns the position inside a `data` envelope. When the position is **closed** (no credit, no debt, no remaining collateral) or has never existed for a known market, the endpoint returns zero balances with `type: null`. Positions with `credit == 0 && debt == 0` but non-empty `collaterals` are returned as `type: "collateral_only"`.

user-address.description: User address for the requested position. Lowercase input is checksummed.

tools.name: morpho_midnight_get_user_position_performance
tools.description:
Performance-only lookup for a single position by `(market-id, user-address)`.

Returns performance analytics inside a `data` envelope. `effective_rate_wad` is compounded IRR+ using a 365.25-day year; `effective_apr` is simple interest using a 365-day year and is capped at `10` (1000%). The position detail endpoint omits these fields to keep state and performance concerns separate. When the position is closed or has never existed for a known market, this endpoint returns `type: null` and null analytics.

user-address.description: User address for the requested position. Lowercase input is checksummed.

tools.name: morpho_midnight_get_offer_group
tools.description:
Returns every offer group matching the onchain group id, regardless of lifecycle status. The maker is not required; optional chain_id and maker query parameters can disambiguate the lookup. Distinct chain, maker, and group-id combinations remain separate, and no match returns an empty data array.

The endpoint returns every latest offer revision in each matched group and exposes the current lifecycle as `status`. Each group exposes the shared offer intent as `type`, or `null` when its latest offers have inconsistent `buy` and `reduce_only` values. It does not apply Router mempool admission policy: oracle, token, market-triplet, LLTV, RCF threshold, and other mempool-validation policy checks do not gate retrieval.

Each nested offer includes the exact per-offer `ratifier_data` bytes originally submitted, plus `parsed_ratifier_data`, a structured view discriminated by `ratifier_type`. The type is identified by matching `ratifier` against the chain's known Midnight ratifier deployments: `rate_v1` exposes `rate_per_second_wad` and `allowed_taker`, `price_v1` exposes `allowed_taker` (the offer-level `tick` is the ratified price), and `ecrecover` and `setter` expose only their type. A zero `allowed_taker` means any taker may take the offer. An unrecognized ratifier address returns `unknown`; a recognized address whose `ratifier_data` cannot be decoded returns `invalid` with `expected_ratifier_type`.

tools.name: morpho_midnight_list_user_offer_groups
tools.description:
Cursor-paginated list of a user's offer groups with nested offers. The `statuses` filter accepts one or more lifecycle states with OR semantics. The deprecated singular `status` parameter is a single-value alias; requests containing both are rejected. Omitting both defaults to `active` for backward compatibility.

**Maturity policy.** The list includes only offers whose maturity is at 15:00 UTC, the maturities Router quotes. Other offers are excluded before lifecycle, filters, type, callback, and group `expiry` are computed, and groups with no such offer are omitted. The by-group endpoint returns every offer regardless of maturity.

Lifecycle is derived from every latest 15:00 UTC offer revision before market, asset, maturity, type, callback, or listing filters are applied. `cancelled` has highest priority and requires an explicit `SetConsumed(type(uint128).max)` event; a `Take` reaching the same numeric value remains `filled`. Otherwise, a group is `filled` when every latest leg has no remaining capacity. It is `active` when at least one remaining leg has started and is at or before both its expiry and non-zero maturity. It is `scheduled` when no leg is active but at least one remaining leg starts in the future without having expired or matured. All remaining groups are `expired`. Active takes remain valid at exact expiry or maturity, matching the onchain inclusive boundary.

Nested offers are lifecycle-targeted for list results: active returns live remaining-capacity legs, scheduled returns future remaining-capacity legs, filled and cancelled return all latest legs, and expired returns terminal expired or matured legs. Active and scheduled group `expiry` is the maximum not-yet-ended latest-offer horizon; terminal statuses use the complete latest set. Requesting all five statuses returns every group with a 15:00 UTC offer exactly once.

**Callbacks.** A group has `callback.type=blue_buy` only when every latest offer considered for the lifecycle has the same callback address and data, contains canonical Blue market parameters with the matching loan token, and the earliest indexed registration from the official factory names the maker as owner at or before the offer's creation block. Registration transaction or log order within the same block is intentionally ignored. The callback is `null` when any condition fails. Verified callbacks include their address, decoded Blue market parameters, and derived Blue market id.

**Types.** Group `type` is derived from the shared `buy` and `reduce_only` values across all offers considered for the requested lifecycle. `buy` and `sell` mean `reduce_only=false`; `buy_reduce_only` and `sell_reduce_only` mean `reduce_only=true`. For the portfolio, `buy` and `sell_reduce_only` represent lend orders and secondary exits, while `sell` and `buy_reduce_only` represent borrow orders and secondary exits. Inconsistent groups return `type: null` and do not match the `types` filter. This describes offer intent, not the maker's current position.

**Filters.** `market_ids` filters the group page to groups containing at least one offer in the requested lifecycle and any requested market, but does not narrow nested sibling offers. `chain_ids` and `groups` filter the group page and nested offers. `loan_assets`, `collateral_assets`, exact `maturities`, and the inclusive unix-second bounds `maturity_gte` and `maturity_lte` filter both the group page and returned offers in the requested lifecycle for every status, and combine with other filters using AND semantics. `types` accepts comma-separated offer-group types with OR semantics and combines with other filters using AND semantics without narrowing nested offers. `callback_type=blue_buy` keeps only groups with verified Blue callback metadata. `listed=true` requires every lifecycle-matching offer in a group to be on a listed market; `listed=false` requires at least one lifecycle-matching unlisted offer. Address filters match across all chains unless `chain_ids` a

user-address.description: User address whose offer groups should be listed.

status.description: Deprecated single-value alias for statuses. Omit both status and statuses to return active groups.

statuses.description: Filter by one or more offer-group lifecycle states using OR semantics. Combined with other filters using AND semantics. Omit both status and statuses to return active groups.

callback_type.description: Filter by verified group callback type. blue_buy requires canonical Blue market params and an official factory registration owned by the maker at or before offer creation.

types.description: Filter by group offer intent. Multiple values use OR semantics. buy and sell mean reduce_only=false; buy_reduce_only and sell_reduce_only mean reduce_only=true. Combined with other filters using AND semantics.

chain_ids.description: Filter by chain ids. Supported chains: Ethereum (1), Base (8453), Arc (5042), and Robinhood Chain (4663).

market_ids.description: Filter groups to those containing offers in the requested lifecycle and Midnight markets. Nested offers are not narrowed by this filter.

market_family_ids.description: Filter groups to those containing offers in the requested lifecycle and Midnight market families. Combined with market_ids using AND semantics. Nested offers are not narrowed by this filter.

loan_assets.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by loan token addresses. Combined with market_ids, collateral_assets, maturities, and groups using AND semantics.

collateral_assets.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by configured collateral token addresses. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, maturities, and groups using AND semantics; lowercase input is checksummed.

maturities.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by exact market maturity timestamps, in unix seconds. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, collateral_assets, and groups using AND semantics.

maturity_gte.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by market maturity greater than or equal to this unix timestamp. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, collateral_assets, maturities, and groups using AND semantics.

maturity_lte.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by market maturity less than or equal to this unix timestamp. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, collateral_assets, maturities, and groups using AND semantics.

groups.description: Filter by offer group ids. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, collateral_assets, and maturities using AND semantics.

created_at_gte.description: Filter for group created_at greater than or equal to this unix timestamp.

created_at_lte.description: Filter for group created_at less than or equal to this unix timestamp.

listed.description: Filter by market listing status. When true, returns only groups where every offer in the requested lifecycle is on a listed market; when false, groups with at least one lifecycle-matching offer on an unlisted market. Omit to return both.

sort_by.description: Sort field for group cursor pagination.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for group cursor pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page response.

tools.name: morpho_midnight_get_book_quote
tools.description:
Returns a bundle-ready quote for the requested assets or units, plus expected best/worst average prices and maximum executable liquidity.

The endpoint optimizes for successful target-aware bundle execution under contention: `takeable_offers` are best-priced per-offer caps and their total can exceed the requested target, giving a bundle executor fallback liquidity when earlier offers are partially consumed or skipped.

At most `limit` (default and maximum 10,000) best-priced takeable offers are walked and returned; prices and availability always describe exactly the returned window. A request that cannot fill within `limit` offers returns 422.

Use the returned takeable offers with a bundle abstraction that stops at your requested target and applies your max/min asset or unit protections. If you execute takeable offers independently with Midnight.take, do not submit every returned unit blindly: clamp each offer to your remaining target and current takeability, or you may execute more than intended.

If the requested size cannot be fully satisfied at quote time under the selected guard, the endpoint returns 422.

limit.description: Maximum number of best-priced takeable offers the quote may walk and return. Returned prices and availability describe exactly this window, and a request that cannot fill within `limit` offers returns 422. Maximum: 10000. Default: 10000.

average_worst_price.description: Optional conservative average worst-price guard for the requested target. For `asks`, the returned `average_worst_price` is at or below this value; for `bids`, it is at or above it. The target-closing offer is clipped exactly when needed, and only whole additional fallback caps whose conservative bound remains inside the guard are returned. If the target itself cannot satisfy the guard, the request fails with 422. Mutually exclusive with `slippage`.

slippage.description: Optional slippage percentage used to derive a worst-price guard from the realized `average_best_price` for the requested target. The returned fallback window is trimmed until its conservative `average_worst_price` stays inside that guard. For `asks`, the guard increases by slippage; for `bids`, it decreases by slippage. The response reports the conservative bound, not the derived guard. Range: 0.1 to 100, with at most one decimal place. Mutually exclusive with `average_worst_price`.

units.description: Target unit amount. Provide exactly one of `assets` or `units`.

assets.description: Target assets amount. Provide exactly one of `assets` or `units`.

market-id.description: Market ID whose book to quote (`market_id` in responses).

tools.name: morpho_midnight_list_maker_takeable_offers
tools.description: Returns one maker's active offers. A fresh offer is withheld until measured, unless indexed ratifier state proves both a blocker and maker intent through the tree signature, signer-authorization history, or root history. Eligible blocked offers return with `units` set to `0`; missing state and unproven offers naming the maker remain hidden.

maker.description: Maker EVM address. Matching is case-insensitive.

market_ids.description: Comma-separated market IDs (32-byte hex). Matches takeable offers in any of the provided markets. Maximum 20 IDs. Combined with `groups` using AND semantics.

groups.description: Comma-separated group IDs (32-byte hex). Matches takeable offers in any of the provided groups. Maximum 20 IDs.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.
